text:
Anna W: Quick ask — we need a compact launch asset kit for next Wed's webinar + social push. Scope: 4-slide carousel (desktop + mobile crops), responsive hero (1200x600 + 600x315), webinar 16:9 cover, 3 quote cards, transparent speaker cutouts, and a CSV with copy keys and 3 headline variants per social card. Also alt text drafts. Delivery: Tue 9am PT. Can design take?

Leah (Design): Yep, I can take this. A couple clarifying Qs: are we using the v2 brand tokens (yes/no), and do you want one stat tile (SVG) or a small comparison bar chart for the carousel?

Samir M: Use v2 tokens. Please provide both tile and small comparison viz so we can AB test. For tracking: include UTM template utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=inference_launch_2026 and put campaign tag inference-launch-2026 in copy. Also add hidden form field `source=webinar_social` on the webinar CTA so Ops can segment.

Priya (Ops): Confirmed routing: HubSpot will ingest utm_campaign and we can map `creative_version` as a custom property for A/B. Please name assets with a version suffix so we can tie to the creative_version value (e.g., v1, v2).

Matt P (PM): Legal asked for a low-contrast microline on the webinar cover: "Based on internal benchmarks; individual results may vary." Keep it small (10px on web) and include an export without the microline for paid placements.

Leah (Design): Noted. I'll include two hero exports: with-legal and without-legal. Will deliver:
- Full PNGs (desktop) x4
- Mobile crops x4
- 16:9 webinar cover (PNG + layered PSD)
- 3 quote cards (PNG + SVG for icons)
- speaker PNG cutouts (transparent)
- stat tile as SVG + PNG
- copy CSV with keys and 3 headline variants per slot
- alt text file (CSV) and a contrast report screenshot

Samir M: For naming convention, follow this pattern so Ops can bulk-map:
`assets/launch_2026/{component}/{locale}/{name}_v{n}_{breakpoint}.png`
Example: `assets/launch_2026/carousel/en/slide-01_v1_desktop.png`

Anna W: We also need localized overlay copies for EN/FR/DE — basic text only, no art redesign. Leah, can you mock the text layers so translations can be swapped easily?

Leah (Design): Yes — I'll keep text on separate layers, use placeholder tokens for copy keys, and export a CSV with keys matching the file names. I'll also add visual padding guides so translations don't overflow.

Priya (Ops): In HubSpot mapping: set lifecycle=Lead for webinar signups, add `source=webinar_social` custom field, and set `campaign=inference-launch-2026`. If you can include the UTM template in a README inside the asset zip that'd be great.

Leah (Design): Will include README with UTMs, naming rules, and export checklist. Also including alt text snippets and 3 headline variants per card (short | short+emoji | long). ETA: first mock frames by Mon EOD, final exports Tue 8:30am PT.

Samir M: Tag me when Figma is up. I'll run a quick pass on the comparison viz; might request a tighter baseline. :mag:

design-bot: Drafts uploaded to Figma https://figma.com/file/efgh5678/launch-mini-kit — frames: carousel_drafts, hero_with_legal, hero_no_legal, stat_tile_v1

Anna W: Great. I'll review tonight and loop Legal & Ops tomorrow AM. If all green we can wire HubSpot and schedule the webinar page. :rocket:
